games.name: [EVENT!] Chainsaw Man Devil's Heart
games.desc:
Controls: 
M = Skill Tree 
Q = Dash/Dodge 
F = Parry 
E = Interact With Npcs 
Z,X,C,V = Skills (If You Have It) 
T = Activate Hybrid/Fiend (If you Have It) 
Alt = Shift Lock
Shift = Run 
Abilities Are Activated By Pressing The Tools
(To use tools on XBOX Press Y the number of times, so hotbar 2 is 2 times) 

Codes (Used In Settings)
TheySeeMeAuraRerolllling (Aura Reroll)
TRADINGISHERE

-------------How To Play?------------- 
You start of by doing the cleaning quest, After that you kill fiends & do quests as you level up you gain skill points which can be used to level & upgrade your skill tree! there's raids, hybrids like Chainsaw Man, katana man, and many other things after that! Goodluck 

Devil Heart's Have A 50/50 Chance To Spawn Every 30m 

Makima Spawns every 2 hours in a specific spot

(Daily Quest Gives X2 Rewards and can only be done once per day) 

Private servers do not spawn hearts (Shutdown = Update)

games.name: One of Us
games.desc:
Welcome to One of Us.. 🔪

GAME IS IN ALPHA -- EXPECT BUGS.

Use Code "40KLIKES" for an in-game reward! 💰
Next Code at 50,000 Likes! 👍

Up to 6 players enter each match… but one of them hides a dark secret. 😈

One player is secretly the Killer, able to transform between human and monster form at will. Blend in with the group — or strike when no one expects it. Each Killer comes with a unique ability that changes how they hunt.

The rest are Survivors, who must:
⚙️ Repair all the generators to restore power
🕵️ Work together to figure out who the Killer is
🚔 Either call the police and survive until they arrive — or
🪵 Find a stake chest and take down the Killer themselves!

Trust no one. Every choice could be your last.
Will you survive the night… or become the next victim?

👍 Don't forget to LIKE and FAVORITE the game to stay updated on all the latest features and improvements! ⭐
